notes: This portable C++ TCK case exercises the public RTIambassador::connect path against an adapter-controlled loopback peer. The peer returns two malformed CTRL_NEW_SESSION_STATUS frames: a valid nonzero Session ID with the reserved invalid sequence value, then a valid sequence value with zero Session ID. The public call must report ConnectionFailed for both, and the adapter observes the client close both sockets. Scope is limited to federate-side receipt of these two status-frame metadata failures; it does not test other frame types, RTI-host receive behavior, independent-provider interoperability, or complete §12.13.4.6 conformance.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador::connect reports ConnectionFailed when an adapter-controlled peer responds with invalid New Session Status session metadata; adapter observes client socket closure
